plan.title: Tofu core: karts, verbs, loose ball, one rival
plan.contract:
Bumper-kart football on flat shapes: p1 (red/cream #c8342c/#f2e6c8) against mint_1 (#8fd9b6, same kart), deck, loose ball, goals. Start from ref/seeds/seed_paddle + seed_drive. Keep lean (about 800 lines). Player decisions win over card and brief: NO spin bat, NEVER carried (no TLBall.hold, spring or anchor), NO named rivals. All numbers below go in data/tuning.json, keys named as written.
WORLD: data/venue.json (tl.layout/1) = flat deck on floor layer 1 plus kit goal parts scaled to 14 x 4 m. x -22..22, z -36..36; red attacks -z. Board outline (1 m visual, rounded 6 m corners, restitution 0.7) is resolved in scripts/core/deck.gd, no wall bodies. Karts: TLBodies.make cylinder radius 0.9, mass 200, dynamic, lock y rx ry rz, mask 0, visual false, track false; motion, heading, kart-kart and kart-board contacts are script-owned (not TLVehicle). Ball: TLBall planar, radius 1.2, mass_ratio 0.25, restitution 0.7, drag 0.3/s, cap 30; masks only the floor; set_velocity.
DRIVE: cruise 12, boost 18, accel 14/22, brake 24, reverse 6, turn 3.2/2.4 rad/s; tank 100, burn 33/s; kickoff boost 33, conceding side 66 (tail lamps glow).
ACTIONS: forward W, back S, left A, right D, boost Shift, bump Space, whirl E + right mouse, restart R, skip_lesson Enter.
BALL TOUCH: states &"loose",&"struck". Relative normal speed under soft_touch_max 13: ball leaves at kart normal speed + 1 (pushable, rolls free); else restitution 0.7 along centre line.
VERBS (pose in 3 f, readable by 6): bump 5/7/12, lunge +4 m/s, cone 35 deg, no auto-aim, no cancel; ball +14 m/s along contact line, +20 if contact in first 3 active frames. ram: hold boost, windup 6, active up to 180, recovery 12, cancels into bump/whirl; closing >=14 is a ram. whirl 4/18/24, guard frames 1-18, swats ball 14 m/s tangentially. Bot bump, ram and whirl each start with a 24 f tell (driver rears, pennant whips back).
CONTACTS (both karts; hit-stop in brackets): touch <6: rebound 0.6, thud [0]. bump flank: victim spinout 75, speed halved, attacker recoils 3 [4]. rear: victim shoved 7 forward, wobble 24, attacker half speed [3]. nose: both rebound 5, snap [3]. clash: both 8 [5]. ram flank/rear: spinout 90, thrown 6, attacker keeps 40% and jolts [8]. ram head-on: both 9, slower spinout 75 [6]. bump/ram into whirl: attacker spinout 75, whirler holds, +10 boost [6]. whiff bump: full recovery, twang. whiff whirl: 24 f no steer, speed x0.6. Teammates only rebound. Spinout brakes 10 m/s2; during it and 90 f after, hits only jolt. Hit-stop is held by the pack on those two karts only; victim visual vibrates, decaying.
SHAKE: bumps none; ram involving p1 (0.15,10); goal (0.25,18). TLAudio thuds, clang, twang, charge bell, horn, cheer; TLVfx sparks on rams only, confetti on goals; no technical markers. Sweet shot and swat: 4 f hit-stop on kart and ball visual, clang, TLVfx.squash ball.
POSES (scripts/core/pose.gd, own, no biped clips): kart_bump (lean back, spring compresses, lunge, wobble), kart_ram (tub squats, nose lifts, hunch; squash on contact), kart_whirl (tilt pirouette, arms high), kart_spinout (rock, head lolls, hands off), kart_wobble, kart_jolt (jerk from blow), goal_wave.
gen/kart_flat.gd: static generate(ctx) (no-op), static build(team)->Node3D "Visual" with nodes Ring (fat black), Tub, Spring, Driver(Head striped helmet, ArmL, ArmR), Pole (3 m), Pennant, TailLampL, TailLampR; each node's meshes sit in a child "Flat". p1 has pine_light SelfRing. Ball visual "BallVisual": hot seam rim, ground shadow.
CAMERA view "play" (add_view, moved every frame): 8 back (+z) 7 up of p1, look height 1, fov 46, ~4 f lag, heading FIXED toward the far goal, never swings; fade_occluders; p1 about 0.2 of frame.
RULES: TLRules sides red,mint, score_to_win 3, paused outside live; countdown 180, mirrored spots red [[0,14],[-9,20],[9,26]] (mint negated), centred ball; goal hold 90, bump skips; at 180 s live leader wins else golden; end banner, restart works at once.
LESSON (match 0): mint_1 shuttles side-on 3 m beside the ball across p1's lane every 6 s until spun once; that first spin lasts 180 f, no throw even from a ram, and leaves the p1-ball-goal line clear (kart 2.5 m off it) so one straight nudge sends the ball goalward. Hints: 'W drive, SHIFT boost, SPACE bump its side', 'now shove the ball home', 'E whirl' at first charge bell. After it mint_1 uses brain_core: attacks ball and p1 in bursts of 3, whirls when a closer is within 9 m, never still over 60 f.
HUD: labels score_red, clock, score_mint, hint, boost, banner (set_text); ball edge arrow on a TLHudLayer. Avoid variable names starting score/clock/timer/period/lap.
MODULE SEAM (later packages): for n in teams, show, look: if ctx.root.has_meta("kk_mod_"+n), ctx.load_script(meta).new(); call mod_setup(ctx, game) after core setup, mod_tick(frame) after core logic, mod_state() into state[n], mod_save()/mod_load(d) when present (core implements _pack_save/_pack_load). game = main: ctx, cfg, karts, player, ball{body,pos,vel,state,last_id,last_team,visual}, rules, hud, phase(&"countdown",&"live",&"goal_hold",&"over"), golden, tier(0..2), match_index, events, core_scoreboard, core_endcard (true); add_kart(id,team,slot), kart_by_id(id), add_boost(k,v), restart_match(), lesson_active(), far_loop_active() (first 900 live f of match 0; skip_lesson ends both). Kart: id,team,pos,heading,vel,boost,state(&"drive",&"tell",&"bump",&"ram_windup",&"ram",&"ram_recover",&"whirl",&"spinout",&"wobble",&"goal_wave"),state_frame,immune,stop,brain,visual. brain.think(kart,game)->{throttle,steer,boost,bump,whirl}. Ids p1,red_2,red_3,mint_1..3. events (cleared each tick) {type: contact{kind: touch,flank,rear,nose,clash,ram_flank,ram_rear,ram_headon,whirl_block,jolt,mate; attacker,victim}, ball_touch{kart,kind: push,bounce,bump,sweet,swat}, whiff{kart,verb}, tell{kart,verb}, possession{team,cause: bumped,spun,whirled,rammed,outraced; from}, goal{team,scorer,own}, countdown_start, kickoff, match_over{winner}}. State: rules snapshot, phase, golden, time_left_s, lesson, karts[], ball{}, events.
TOFU CHECK: tests/bot_tofu.gd reports metrics feedback_f, skill_spread, skill_variants, idle_max_f, tell_min_f, tells, pressure_waves, lead_change_share, close_rounds, verbs_used, possession_median_f, scrum_share, overlap_share
Bounds, all counted from played frames: feedback_f<=3; skill_spread 0.25..0.95 (bump on ball: sweet/late/angled, >=5 each, outcome ball speed); skill_variants>=3; idle_max_f<=120; tell_min_f>=20; tells>=3; pressure_waves>=2 (180 f window with >=3 attack starts after one with <=1); lead_change_share>=0.3 over >=3 matches; close_rounds>=1 (loser within one point); verbs_used>=3 (bump, ram, whirl, each >=3); possession_median_f 240..600 (side of last touch until other side touches or goal); scrum_share<=0.3 (4+ karts within 5 m of ball); overlap_share<=0.02 (overlap >0.1 m). Also hand, and moments {flank,rear,clash,ram_flank,whirl_block,sweet,goal,spin_bat_goal (flank spin then p1 goal),whirl_turnaround,sunset_ram}; plays the lesson first.

plan.title: Three against three, utility bots, boost pads
plan.contract:
Turns the core into 3 v 3 with no goalies. Player decisions: ball is NEVER held, no spin bat or FEED option, rivals are one mint team in identical karts with no names or special habits. Do not edit core files.
HOOK: gen/mod_teams.gd static generate(ctx) does ctx.root.set_meta("kk_mod_teams","scripts/teams/teams.gd"); also static build_pad(big: bool)->Node3D (flat disc / brass lamp post under 1 m, TLStyle.flat_material). teams.gd: mod_setup(ctx, game), mod_tick(frame), mod_state().
SETUP: game.add_kart("red_2","red",1), ("red_3","red",2), ("mint_2","mint",1), ("mint_3","mint",2); set kart.brain on all five bots (replaces mint_1's brain_core; the core still drives mint_1 during game.lesson_active()). brain.think(kart, game) -> {throttle: -1..1, steer: -1..1, boost, bump, whirl}; bump/whirl true on the press frame; the core adds the 24 f tell to every bot bump, ram and whirl. While game.far_loop_active() the four other bots drive loops in the far half (z<-12) and never approach the ball.
AI (copy the structure of engine/packs/hockey/scripts/ai/carrier.gd and roles.gd; weights in data/ai.json): decide every frame, no reaction delay. Roles &"attacker",&"support",&"last" re-sorted by time to ball, 0.3 s hysteresis; commitment bonus 0.15. Options &"shoot" = 1.6*shot_chance - 0.3*pressure (veto under 0.08); &"knock" (to a mate) = 1.2*lane_safety*openness*(0.5+gain) (veto lane under 0.35); &"push" = 0.9*space*(1-pressure) + 0.15; defence &"pressure",&"block",&"guard". Never aim at the own goal. TLSteer.pursue, arrive, separate 6 m unless contesting (keeps scrum_share <= 0.3). Bump the ball to shoot or knock; bump or ram opponents on flank or rear; read a closing attacker and whirl when it is within 9 m (the 24 f tell plus 4 f wind-up must finish before contact). No bot stands still over 60 f.
MATES: red_2 attacks and drives the goal, red_3 covers; both shoot freely, give way when p1 is about to touch the ball (stay 4 m off p1's nose), and flash TailLamps when open (lane safety*openness over 0.6).
TIERS read game.tier 0 rookie,1 pro,2 allstar: aim_error_deg 6/3.5/1.5; sweet_chance 0.20/0.50/0.75; whirl_read 0.25/0.50/0.70; allstar also feints (starts a tell, drives off), knocks and blocks lanes more. Mates use pro. Equal speeds, accel and boost on every tier. All randomness ctx.rng.
PADS data/pads.json: 10 small at x +-11, z -24,-12,0,12,24: give 12, return 4 s; 4 big at (+-18, +-30): give 100, return 10 s, 7 s once either side has 2 goals (match point). Pickup by distance 1.5 m in the plane, game.add_boost(kart, v), capped 100; an empty pad visibly sinks or dims; all return on countdown_start. Sound on pickup. Low bots detour to pads when it costs under 1 s. Append event {type:"pad", kart, amount, big} to game.events.
mod_state(): {roles:{id:role}, option:{id:option}, pads:[{x,z,big,ready}]}.
TUNE: keep side possession median 4-10 s.
TESTS: tests/bot_teams.gd (taps skip_lesson at frame 1, plays p1 with a perfect TLHand to the end): ok needs 6 karts, no bot idle over 60 f, every bot tell >= 24 f, at least one shot by each side, a red mate touch, 3 pad pickups, all measured; reports metrics possession_median_f, scrum_share, overlap_share, idle_max_f and moments mate_shot, mint_tell, pad_pickup, whirl_block, goal (first ones within 600 f). tests/bot_hand_newcomer.gd per card.team_possession: a newcomer TLHand plays tier 0; reports result and hand.stats(). bot_hand_perfect (core's) must still pass: player check on tier 0.

plan.title: TV scoreboard, drama, end card, nights
plan.contract:
The match as a TV show: screen, sound and stakes. Moves no kart or ball. No spin bat, no carrying, no named rivals.
HOOK: gen/mod_show.gd static generate(ctx) does ctx.root.set_meta("kk_mod_show","scripts/show/show.gd"). show.gd: mod_setup(ctx, game), mod_tick(frame), mod_state(), mod_save(), mod_load(d). Reads game.events {type: contact, ball_touch, whiff, tell, possession{team,cause,from}, goal{team,scorer,own}, countdown_start, kickoff, match_over{winner}, pad}, game.phase, game.golden, game.rules, game.karts, game.player, game.tier, game.match_index. Writes only game.core_scoreboard=false, game.core_endcard=false, game.tier. Remove core labels score_red, clock, score_mint, banner with game.hud.remove_widget; leave hint and boost.
BOARD (the player's note: 'a big score board at the top, red score, clock, mint score, like a TV game'): TLHud.add_layer(&"tv"), top centre about 760 x 120 units: red plate with large score, centre plate with 3:00 counting down (from game's time_left_s: 180 - rules.seconds_played()), mint plate with large score; pennant name of the night (ROOKIE, PRO, ALL-STAR) under it; 'MATCH POINT' and 'GOLDEN GOAL' strips. Countdown 3, 2, 1 large with beeps; GOAL banner during goal_hold with scorer (YOU, RED, MINT, own goal) and 'SPACE skips'.
WHY YOU LOST IT: on a possession event that takes the ball from p1's side, one line under the board for 90 f naming the cause: bumped 'Mint bumped it away', spun 'You were spun out', whirled 'Mint whirled it off you', rammed 'Mint rammed you', outraced 'Mint got there first'. Counts are kept for p1.
CHARGERS: edge arrow on the tv layer for any mint kart in state tell or ram that is off screen (lay.project).
INTENSITY (data/show.json): calm countdown, kickoff peak (whistle, cheer), loose scramble, quiet breath for the goal hold; match point: a pulse beat (TLAudio.play beep) every 30 f, quickening to 20 f in golden goal; golden goal: horn, cheer, a brief rose screen_fade of at most 0.15, repeated bursts of cheer. Never add hit-stop or extra shake (core owns feel). A sweet bump during golden goal records moment sunset_ram.
END CARD: winner, final goals, goals by you, your spin-outs, biggest loss cause with its count and answer, e.g. 'Mint whirled you 5 times: wait out the whirl' (answers per cause in data/show.json), fastest win in seconds, 'R rematch'. Visible within 60 f of match_over; R (core) restarts within 2 s; card clears on countdown_start. A red win raises game.tier by 1 (max 2) before the next match and records fastest win; a loss keeps the tier. mod_save returns {tier, fastest_s}; mod_load restores them.
mod_state(): {board:{red,mint,time_text,strip}, card:{shown,winner,spinouts,cause,cause_count,text}, night, fastest_s, callout}.
tests/bot_show.gd: perfect TLHand plays p1 (drive at the ball from the far side of the mint goal, bump) through one match, reads state show, presses restart; ok needs the board text matching rules scores on every sampled frame, a callout after a real loss, the end card with winner and cause, the next countdown within 120 f of restart, tier raised if red won. Reports moments countdown, goal, callout, end_card, sunset_ram.

plan.title: Sunset pier pavilion and painted fairground tubs
plan.contract:
Visual only: no collision that touches play, no state, speed or rule change. All shown in camera "play" (steady, behind and above p1, looking at the far goal; do not change it).
HOOK: gen/mod_look.gd static generate(ctx) does ctx.root.set_meta("kk_mod_look","scripts/look/look.gd"). look.gd: mod_setup(ctx, game) after all karts exist (loads after teams), mod_tick(frame), mod_state() returns {sky_step, lamps_on, lanterns_on}. Geometry lives in gen/pier/*.gd static builders, using kit parts first and TLStyle.flat_material; no own materials, lights, sky or environment.
KARTS (the player's note, follow it): 'a round fairground tub on a fat black rubber ring, a kid driver in a striped crash helmet, a little pennant on a pole; my team red and cream stripes, theirs mint green'. Each game.karts[i].visual has nodes Ring, Tub, Spring, Driver(Head, ArmL, ArmR), Pole, Pennant, TailLampL, TailLampR, each with meshes in a child "Flat". Hide "Flat" and add a new child under the same node, so the core's poses keep driving them; never move or rename those nodes. Round glossy tub with red/cream stripes (#c8342c/#f2e6c8) or mint (#8fd9b6) stripes, same shape for both; visible spring nose; kid bust with striped helmet and gloved arms; pole top at 3 m, little pennant clearly above the 2.4 m ball; tail lamps visibly glow when boost at kickoff is 66. Keep SelfRing (pine_light) clear.
BALL: dress game.ball.visual: huge stitched leather panels, hot-coloured seam rim, ground shadow kept; the stitching rolls with motion; squash by the core must still show.
PIER (data/pier.json via TLKit.build_layout from look.gd, plus gen/pier): plank deck 72 x 44 m with centre line and circle, 1 m painted boards following the rounded 6 m corner outline exactly, goals 14 x 4 m with nets and team bunting, 4 brass lamps at (+-18,+-30) floor corners, outside the boards: pier edge, railings, sea all round, roof arch ribs (arch_rib), light masts (light_mast), flags, bunting, a few stalls and stands. Arches, masts, flags and anything taller than the boards stand at least 10 m beyond the boards (goals excepted), so the camera never meets them; no pillar on the play surface; nothing hides ball, drivers or pennants.
SUNSET (the player keeps 'Beat The Sunset'): a far backdrop of sea horizon and sky bands whose colour steps gold -> orange -> rose with rules.seconds_played() at 0, 60, 120 s; the 4 lamps and mast lamps switch to a glowing colour at 90 s; when game.golden, the sky goes dusk and deck-edge lanterns light. Resets on a countdown_start of a new match (game.match_index changes). Step times and colours in data/look.json. Global inked toon style, golden-to-rose mood. No technical markers at impacts.
Budget: at most 600 physics bodies and 5,000 nodes under the pack; p99 tick under 8 ms: build once, merge static scenery, update only on step changes. The view "play" at kickoff must differ clearly from the greybox: striped tubs, planks, boards, sea and sunset.

plan.title: Rainbow prize boxes and the homing red shell
plan.contract:
The player's request: floating prize boxes give a homing red shell, F fires it, a hit tumbles a kart; Q jump and E whirl beat it; mint bots use them too. Original look, not any existing game's art: a painted seaside fairground prize box and a glossy red clamshell. Do not edit any kept file. Everything else plays as before. All numbers in data/items.json, keys named as written.
HOOK: gen/mod_items.gd static generate(ctx) does ctx.root.set_meta("kk_mod_items","scripts/items/items.gd"); static build_box()->Node3D (cube 1.2 m, rainbow striped faces, TLStyle.flat_material colours) and build_shell()->Node3D (red clamshell 0.6 m). WIRE (core, re-opened after this merge): in scripts/main.gd's module seam the names list becomes teams, show, look, items, so items.gd's mod_setup(ctx, game) runs after look, mod_tick(frame) after the core logic each frame, mod_state() into state["items"]. Until the core is wired this package does nothing and the game is unchanged.
INPUT: mod_setup declares fire_item [KEY_F] and jump [KEY_Q] through ctx.input.declare. Whirl stays the core's E / right mouse.
BOXES: box_spots [[0,-12],[-12,10],[12,10]] (x,z), float at box_height 1.6 m, bob 0.2 m, spin 2 rad/s. A kart whose centre comes within box_radius 1.8 m (planar; jumping karts too) takes it if it holds no item: box hides, burst confetti small, TLAudio.play beep; returns after box_return_s 8. All boxes return on countdown_start. Hidden during game.lesson_active() and game.far_loop_active().
HELD SHELL: one item per kart; a held shell spins over the tub at 3.4 m (above pennant level readable over the ball) on the kart's visual, visible to all.
FIRE (F for p1; bots by brain): one shell alive per kart at a time. Shell leaves the nose at shell_speed 26 m/s, skims at y 0.4, glows red, TLVfx.trail red streak; homes on the nearest opponent kart inside a 70 deg forward cone (none: flies straight), turning at shell_turn 3.0 rad/s; lives shell_life_s 4 or until it hits the boards (pops, dust). Script-owned motion, no physics body; hit test by planar distance shell_hit_radius 1.4 to kart centres. Ignores the ball (passes over).
HIT (both karts change, never the shooter's team): victim kart.state=&"spinout" for shell_spin_f 90, speed set to 0 plus throw 4 m/s along the shell's travel, frees ball as core's spun cause (append event possession cause spun when the victim's team had it). Visual only: visual lifted in a tumble arc to tumble_height 3 m over 40 f with 2 full rolls, landing squash; hit-stop shell_stop_f 8 on victim (kart.stop); TLAudio.play hit_steel (BANG), TLVfx.burst sparks, ctx.cameras.shake 0.25 over 14 frames when p1 is victim or shooter, else 0.1; HUD label shelled centre 'SHELLED!' for 60 f (game.hud.add_label once, set_text). Respect core immunity: during a spin-out and its 90 f after, a shell only jolts (no tumble).
BEATING IT: jump (Q): jump_f 30 airborne hop of the visual (peak 1.6 m, tub tucks), cooldown 60; kart.jumping true while airborne; shells pass under. Jump does not change the core body. Whirl: a kart in core state whirl within 2.5 m swats the shell away tangentially (it becomes harmless, flies off 20 m/s, fades), clang, whirler gains 10 boost via game.add_boost. Swat records moment shell_swat.
BOTS (mint and red mates through kart.brain unchanged; items.gd adds its own per-bot item logic): grab a box when it costs under 1.5 s off route; fire when an opponent is in the 70 deg cone within 30 m and lane clear of mates (mint aims at p1 and red mates); on an incoming shell inside 1.0 s: jump or whirl by tier read chance (whirl_read of data/ai.json, rookie 0.25 / pro 0.5 / allstar 0.7), else take it. Bot fire is preceded by a 24 f tell: shell glows bright and rises over the pole. All randomness ctx.rng.
EVENTS appended to game.events: {type:"item", kart, kind: box, fire, hit, jump_dodge, swat, pop}.
mod_state(): {boxes:[{x,z,ready}], held:{id:bool}, shells:[{owner,x,z,target}], shelled_text, jumping:[ids]}.
tests/bot_items.gd: perfect TLHand plays p1 (skip_lesson at frame 1). If state has no "items" key by frame 60 it ends ok true with summary 'items not wired'. Otherwise: drive to a box, fire at a mint kart, jump (Q) on an incoming shell, whirl on another; ok needs p1 took a box, fired, hit a mint kart once, at least one mint shell fired at red, one jump dodge or swat by anyone, boxes returned after 8 s, never two live shells for one kart, no script error. Reports moments box, fire, shell_hit, jump_dodge, shell_swat (first within 900 f) and metrics hits, dodges, swats. bot_hand_perfect (core) must still pass.
